title: Prove the complete joint A/B/restore frame optimum
body:
## Summary

PR3057 left coupled A/B/restore frame reassignment open. This proves the complete fixed-interface optimum for both pinned PR3042 six-skip words.

```text
fixed scalar order, endpoints, centre and warp interfaces
6,141 scalar events -> 743 variable frames -> 210 components
minimum complete local bill = source bill, for every 0 < b <= 1/100
```

Only `research/rank7-joint-frame-optimum/` is added. The package includes the proof, exact source exports, solver-free checker, deterministic component receipts and replay instructions. No new kappa or supplier admission is claimed.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3057 proves only the restore-frame optimum with A/B fixed. **After:** exact interval propagation and variable elimination allow every A/B/restore scalar frame jointly. All 210 components attain their source profile; the largest elimination step has 2,560 cases. Uniform comparisons use discrete concavity and rational logarithm/Taylor bounds.
- Registered Python 3.12 replay and 14 behavioral groups pass, including an actually cheaper coupled fixture, rotated subspaces, a sign-crossing comparison that must reject, and source/axis/warp/invoice/capacity controls. Optimized execution passes; Python 3.12/3.14 receipts match byte for byte.
- Two internal read-only reviews independently reconstruct source graphs and counts; one independently checks every component's first-derivative optimum. No unresolved correctness finding. All 18 committed package files match their tested bytes.

```sh
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/rank7-joint-frame-optimum
```

Canonical main remains `d8e0f83f00191df62174b641e9fff055c357f641`, priority revision 6. Live overlap was refreshed before submission. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612#discussioncomment-18983449). Credit dcharb78, Jeremy Kothe, Marius-Paul Dumitrean, Sagar Thakrar, Gareth Davidson, PR3057 and the retained lineage.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** isolated.

A finite frame-cost theorem in a relaxation, not a new multiplication theorem. Scalar changes, changed warp/centre interfaces, endpoints, inventory and nonmonotone mechanisms remain outside scope. Native/ownership, physical, precision, all-size and outer obligations remain inherited; no full cold replay or outer release is run for this unchanged-word lower bound. Frozen predecessors and the selected frontier stay unchanged.
